Title: clickhouse server does not start after hard shutdown of operating system
Description: > You have to provide the following information whenever possible.

Our virtual machine switched off unexpectedly. After a reboot the clickhouse-server fails to start with exit code 70
```
clickhouse-server.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=70
```
> A clear and concise description of what works not as it is supposed to.

Normal startup with loss of recently written data.

**Does it reproduce on recent release?**
Yes on 21.9.2.17 on Ubuntu 18.04.4 LTS with an ext4 filesystem.

**How to reproduce**

Switch off hard the machine on which clickhouse-server runs while its merging files.

* Which ClickHouse server version to use
ClickHouse 21.8.4.51 with revision 54453,
or
ClickHouse 21.9.2.17 with revision 54454,
